query:
SELECT p.id
               FROM pictures p, pictures src
               WHERE src.id = $2 AND src.local_user_id = $1
                 AND p.local_user_id = $1
                 AND p.id <> src.id
                 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 AND COALESCE(p.content_hash, 'fh:' || p.file_hash)
                     = COALESCE(src.content_hash, 'fh:' || src.file_hash)
               ORDER BY p.id
               LIMIT 1
